'''Sky-sleds''' were a type of [[hovercraft]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Drogheda Royal Guard]] often used sky-sleds with a small [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] mounted to the front of the vessel. Sky-sleds were especially handy for traversing Drogheda's rugged and [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] landscape&mdash;the [[Drogheda Citadel]], the center of [[Politics/Legends|political]] power on the world, was located atop a sheer cliff and was only accessible by sky-sled. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] a [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|popular revolutionary front]] [[Drogheda Civil War|attacked]] the Citadel with sky-sleds, leading to the overthrow of the planet's [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] and paving the way for the installment of a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government.<ref name="marvel83">[[Star Wars (1977) 83|''Star Wars'' (1977) 83]]</ref>
